limitations: The external live inference iframe was deliberately stubbed in the whole-page probe. This does not certify the externally hosted inference service or every legacy site interaction.

Both successful browser runs hung during shutdown after playback and seeking completed; bounded outer timeouts ended only the diagnostic processes. The browser-disconnection/zombie symptom is therefore not evidence of a media decode failure.
The earlier immediate-after-start seek timeout was not reproduced with this play-to-end-then-seek sequence. Its precise cause remains unresolved; no claim is made that the iframe alone caused it.
Aborted metadata/preload requests were followed by successful HTTP206 requests and complete buffering; no HTMLMediaElement error occurred.
recommendation: Keep the reviewed MP4 unchanged. The new component has bounded playback/seek proof; retain the precise full-page external-service and browser-cleanup limitations.
